evidence.observation: Debt position identifiers begin with Debt Securities.
Dominant debt identifiers contain the literal Maturity Date marker.
Debt identifiers embed the headline interest rate after the instrument descriptor.
Floating debt identifiers name SOFR or Prime.
Equity position identifiers begin with Equity Securities.
Equity Investments is a section marker in identifier text.
Cash Equivalents is a section marker in identifier text.
Short-term Investments is a section marker in identifier text.
Bundle none_examples repeatedly contain the aggregate marker Total Investments followed by a parenthesized net-assets percentage.
Bundle none_examples contain the standalone combined-section marker Debt & Equity Securities.

notes: Adds narrow anchors for both marker forms represented in none_examples; Total Investments is an aggregate marker, not a position grammar input.
